provenance.horizontalFrame: legacy local X east, Z south; inverse geo.ts

files.crs_normalization: WFS declares LAMB93; exact conversion parameters checked; replace invalid WMS datum serialization with EPSG:2154; no resampling

provenance.method: Nearest native pixel, 2-decimal metre elevations; 1 m candidate nodes; Delaunay insertion at >0.4 m node residual; shared edges simplified at 0.25 m; coarse perimeter retained. No overhangs.

selection.rule: within pilot bounds, source span >=6 m and 10 m max residual >=1 m; one-cell transition ring; preserve existing walkable road corridor cells
selection.roadProtection: Original validPoint/collision predicate along allowed OSM axes every <=0.25 m; preserve whole 10 m cells within 1.25 m. No new roads or access rights.
